title: Tailwind CSS
description: Utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development.

data.text: Tailwind CSS provides low-level utility classes to build custom designs without leaving your HTML. PostCSS generates the final CSS.

data.caption: Install Tailwind CSS
data.code:
npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p

terms.definition: A single-purpose CSS class (e.g., flex, pt-4).
Tool for transforming CSS with JavaScript.
Just-in-Time compiler that generates styles on demand.

items.text: PostCSS and JIT compile to optimized CSS.
Great for rapid prototyping and production.
